value.rationale: The starting dynamics directly motivates phase diffusion of a sine-driven lift. The first departure from independent phase-kick moments occurs at fifth order, with an exact finite-time threshold n=3, a nontrivial sin(alpha) dependence and a unique arithmetic resonance. This distinguishes a physically defined observable on a published dynamical model beyond qualitative diffusion and earlier scalar lacunary cumulant statements.
